source:
Ari is in a long-distance romance kept alive by phone calls. Looking deeper could turn her life into a movie… or into something else entirely.

[From [url=https://gaby-prueba.itch.io/ari3]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾莉正谈着一场全靠电话维系的异地恋。若是继续深究下去，她的生活或许会变成一出浪漫电影……又或许会彻底滑向另一种截然不同的深渊。

[摘自[url=https://gaby-prueba.itch.io/ari3]itch.io[/url]]
